title: Reality camouflage
subtitle: Only a VLESS server whose scan switch is on is scanned. Each server uses its own address, /24, ASN and region. Education sites are searched for that region; they are not typed in by hand.
schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: The clock uses the panel time zone. A finished day does not run again. Only servers with their own scan switch on are included.
neighbors.title: Neighbor scan
neighbors.description: Only the checked VLESS server's /24, and only port 443. TLS handshake plus one direct request, at most 20 at a time, rate limited. No port scan and no vulnerability probing. A target must offer TLS 1.3 and h2, a valid certificate that is not a CDN edge, a domain that resolves back to that neighbor, HTTP 200/301/302, and a low handshake delay. Cloudflare, Apple, Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Akamai, Fastly and similar sites are excluded.
neighbors.seeds: Extra domains, one per line. Used only when they resolve inside a checked VLESS /24 or the same region.
candidates.title: Candidate domains
candidates.description: CDN and popular names are ignored. If a /24 has no match, the scan tries a .edu site in the same country, state, or a nearby city, then checks DNS and IP geolocation.
switch.title: Automatic switch
switch.description: A switch updates the Reality SNI and destination together and leaves the keys alone. Clients need a fresh subscription before the new SNI works.
switch.serversHint: Leave every box clear to include every VLESS Reality server. Region and ASN come from each checked server, not from the panel.
global.serversHint: Turn a server on to scan its /24 and, when needed, education sites in its region. A server that is off is skipped.
server.eduHint: If this server's /24 has no match, the scan searches the web for education sites in its region and tests them.
server.eduEmpty: No education search for this server yet.

results.truncated: The list was cut at the scan cap.
